text:
elaine: kicking off a config-only rollout during the late window. target: reduce tail and lower token cost. plan: max_concurrency 50 -> 35, global timeout 70s -> 50s, batch_window 10ms -> 5ms. change window 23:00-23:45 PT. canary steps: 2% -> 15% -> 100%. release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-slimline-tilt
release-manager: copy. attach preflight checklist and a short summary here. add abort guards: p95 latency +25% or error rate >0.6% for 3m.
sam: quick ask: can we keep a pinned fallback routing policy (route_policy:stable_v1) and have a fast traffic flip command handy? also split canary traffic across multiple AZs to avoid single-AZ bias.
release-manager: yes. plan: canary at 23:05, observe 8m, bump to 15% at 23:20 if green. rollback hard cutoff 23:38. fallback: route_policy stable_v1 pinned, model fallback variant=stable.
sre-ops: watch p95_latency, overall 5xx_rate, per-tenant 5xx, kv_cache_miss_rate, and gpu_mem_pressure. alert thresholds: 5xx_rate > 0.6% sustained 3m OR p95 > baseline *1.25. Also notify #eng-oncall if tenant-specific errors spike.
elaine: deploying config snippet now:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 35,
  "timeout_s": 50,
  "batch_window_ms": 5,
  "routing_weights": {"canary-small": 2, "default": 98}
}
```
sam: lgtm. I'll run the canary AZ splitter before we start. can we also pre-warm caches for high-qps tenants?
deploybot: deploybot: release "slimline-tilt-config-2026-03" queued by elaine. pipeline: validate -> canary(2%) -> wait(8m) -> canary(15%) -> wait(18m) -> ramp(100%). running preflight smoke.
deploybot: preflight smoke: token create OK, healthcheck OK, generate-fast OK.
sre-ops: good. if kv_cache_miss spikes >15% during first 5m, run /ops/warm_cache.sh and consider delaying 15% bump.
elaine: starting warm-cache for tenants A,B,C now.
deploybot: canary(2%) started at 23:05:12 PT. distributing across 3 AZs. monitoring.
sam: initial metrics: p50 down a touch, p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +18% for tenant B (expected).
sre-ops: tenant B is high qps, watch for error drift. if tenant B errors >0.5% add them to exclude list: `tenant-exclude B`.
deploybot: canary(2%) passed 8m gate at 23:13:20 PT. no abort. proceeding to 15% at 23:20:30 PT.
elaine: thanks. re-running warm-cache quickly before 15%.
sam: at 15% we see a small uptick in backend processing latency correlated with oversized batch submissions from tenant Z. recommend `tenant-exclude Z` for the canary.
sre-ops: applying tenant-exclude Z now. `tenant-exclude Z` -> applied.
deploybot: tenant-exclude Z has been applied.
release-manager: decision: continue to ramp to 100% if no new alerts in the next 15m. rollback window still 23:38.
sre-ops: operational note: if GPU mem pressure >82% and p95 rises, try soft-throttle first: `set batch_window_ms 4` and `max_concurrency 30`. have that command prepared.
elaine: adding soft-throttle entry to runbook: step 1) batch_window_ms -> 4, step 2) max_concurrency -> 30, step 3) monitor 5m.
deploybot: ramp to 100% started at 23:37:50 PT. final checks running.
sam: post-ramp observation: p95 improved ~10% from baseline, token-cost trending down. no sustained 5xx. good signal.
sre-ops: capturing perf snapshot and saving under perf-archive/slimline-tilt/2026-03. alerts clear.
elaine: closing change window early at 23:42. tagging config commit cfg@d4e5f6. pushing final release note update.
release-manager: thanks team. will post a brief post-mortem tomorrow AM and mark release status: success. :party-parrot: 
sam: updating runbook with tenant exclusion and soft-throttle steps.
sre-ops: archiving logs and metrics slices. closing thread.
